referencePolicyDecision: No image reference is required or authorized. Visual style is bound only to the current ProjectBS master concept and background guides; existing Chapter01 battle backgrounds are not content, composition, pixel, edit, or copy sources.

styleContract.cultureEra: Joseon-period Korean mountain villages, roads, markets, shrines, workshops, waterways, and folk-belief spaces only
styleContract.visualLanguage: Korean traditional painting and line-centered graphic treatment with rough charcoal-like ink, dry brush, restrained low-saturation mineral and earth colors, paper grain, and readable layered silhouettes; not photoreal, not 3D/PBR, not Western fantasy
styleContract.battleReadability: one composed side-view 16:9 battlefield with a broad unobstructed central combat lane and small environmental objects kept outside the playable/readability area
styleContract.characterPolicy: environment-only background; no player, NPC, monster, corpse, or crowd
styleContract.textPolicy: no UI, text, logo, readable writing, signage, labels, spawn markers, encounter diagrams, or rewards
styleContract.outcomePolicy: show the encounter location immediately before combat pressure resolves; never depict victory, aftermath, reward, or branch outcome

commonOutputContract.safeArea: central 60% width and lower-middle combat band remain low-detail and free of large blockers
commonOutputContract.finalBackgroundPolicy: single opaque composed background; no separated parallax layers; future target only until generation, evaluation, and promotion are separately approved
commonOutputContract.consistencyLock: one ProjectBS Act01 Korean dark-fantasy background family; fixed side-view game camera, restrained scale, no scene-content borrowing from existing images
